Cemetery Records
One-time cloud setup — takes about 5 minutes

Connect to Supabase (free)

This gives every device — phones in the field, office computers, member devices — access to the same live records and headstone photos.

1
Go to supabase.com and create a free account
2
Click New Project, name it riverside-cemetery, choose a region closest to New York
3
Once created, go to Project Settings → API and copy your Project URL and anon/public key
4
Go to SQL Editor in Supabase and run the setup SQL (tap "Copy SQL" below, paste it there, click Run)
5
Paste your URL and key below and tap Connect
Could not connect. Check your URL and key and try again.

Cloud connection
⚠ Using local storage — not synced across devices
How to connect to Supabase Go to your Supabase project → Settings → API. Copy your Project URL and anon key, paste below, and tap Connect. All records and photos will sync across every device instantly.
QuickBooks Export
Cash Report entries (once sent to the ledger) export as a QuickBooks Desktop .IIF file from the Cash Report page — hand it to your treasurer to import (File → Utilities → Import → IIF Files). Nothing connects to QuickBooks directly; your treasurer stays in control of what posts to the books.
Don't have this from your treasurer yet? Leave it blank — exports will use "Cemetery Checking Account" as a placeholder, and your treasurer can merge it into the real account in QuickBooks with one rename (that's a routine step, not a special setup).
Category accounts (Lot Sale, Payroll, etc.) are created automatically on import if they don't already exist — no need to set those up ahead of time.

Photo storage cleanup
Converts older photos (headstones, issue reports, memorials, map book pages) saved as raw base64 text in the database into compressed files in Storage. Shrinks your database significantly. Safe to run more than once.
Export data
Import records from CSV
Export your Excel file as CSV, then upload it here. Download the template first to see the required column format.
Import from other cemetery software
For exports from PlotBox, CIMS, Cemify, or any other system whose column names don't match our template. Upload their file, map each of their columns to our fields, and optionally save the mapping so you never have to redo it for that software again.
Match their columns to our fields
Fix missing Book Page / Map fields
If earlier records are missing Page #, Map #, or Map Page even though your spreadsheet has that data, upload the same CSV here. This only fills in blank fields on existing records — it never creates duplicates, never overwrites a field that already has a value, and touches nothing else.
